title: Suchie-Pai Adventure: Doki Doki Nightmare
native_title: スーチーパイ・アドベンチャー ～ドキドキ♥ナイトメア～
overview:
A love story with 13 beautiful girls begins now!

- Yay! A huge-capacity 2-CD set!
- Wow! 7 theme songs included!
- Amazing! Over 7,300 animation frames!

Something is going to happen in this town tonight. The heroines of Jaleco's Suchie-Pai series star in an adult adventure where you are the hero. On Disc 1, new characters set off a string of incidents in a Tokyo neighborhood, and the story unfolds as you get to know each girl. On Disc 2, you go out on dates to take the romances you started on Disc 1 further.

- High-quality digital animation
- A cast of 12 voice actors
- Five mini-games

13人の美少女達とのラブストーリーが今始まる！

- ウレシイ～！超大容量CD２枚組！
- オドロキ！テーマソング７曲収録！
- ナント！動画枚数７３００枚以上！
